headline: The shift report stopped losing merges
lede: Every count on the board now walks the whole 48-hour window instead of its first 100 rows — the weekend that printed 99 merges really had 131. Slot b's silent-nights reporting landed in the same hour; combined main is green at 157 gates.

notes.text: #2055: the closed-PR and closed-issue fetches read exactly one per_page=100 page, so a busy window zeroed its oldest hours. Both lists now walk newest-first until the window edge; closed issues sort by updated so an old issue closed on-shift is finally counted.

Live check against real GitHub: the merged code counts 131 in-window merges, the paged API agrees exactly, and git-log holds no PR merge the report misses. The pre-fix code printed 98 for the same window.

Six new harness gates serve synthetic pages from a fake gh: bring back the 100-row cap and exactly three reds name it; revert the sort and exactly two. Slot b's #2096 merged minutes apart on the same files — three-way clean, 157/157 after both.

Queue watch: three consecutive merges are platform-grade and game-queue is empty — flagship README gaps are all owned, so the next builder runs meet the feedback-borrow rung (or Jon's next-title pick).
